verdict.rationale: Off-cycle payroll is a fair question for a global payroll/EOR product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only general multi-country payroll and a read-only 'Retrieve bonuses for engagement' endpoint, with nothing on running payroll outside the regular schedule for bonuses, corrections, or terminations.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run an off-cycle payroll for bonuses, corrections, or terminations outside the regular schedule
